content: ⌊ DRAFT g Since a Applicative Software Cluster can contain several OS Applications , the Os High Proxy shall be able to provide a local IOC implementation for the cluster internal communication paths between OS Applications . The link to the Host Software Cluster shall be established as part of the SwCluCOsProxyOsBaseSocket service resource.
